Implemented in the research engine (arail.research.mini_experiments, archetype game_config_optimization): a measured, one-variable-at-a-time search over a game's settings via a benchmark command you configure, comparing avg FPS and 1% lows against baseline — never a fabricated number, cannot_run when nothing is configured or the benchmark fails. There is no portal UI yet to configure a game's benchmark command and tunables, and no capability adapter is registered, so this still shows unavailable in the capability panel until that wiring lands.

interface.objective: measured avg FPS + 1% lows / frame-time stability
